exposure: diet and lifestyle modification for GDM
outcome: incidence of large- or small-for-gestational-age neonates
cohort: 83 women with GDM treated with metformin (with or without supplemental insulin), matched 1:1 with women receiving insulin or diet and lifestyle modification alone
finding: Women with metformin-treated GDM did not have an increased risk of adverse perinatal outcomes despite their greater BMI.
mod_finding: There was no difference in mode of delivery between the groups.
